expected.summary:
You fire a volley of three arrows in a V that deals Physical and Lightning damage and pierces every enemy in its path. Each enemy it hits calls lightning down on up to 2 other nearby enemies. - In a pack: each hit spawns lightning strikes, and the return trip triggers them again, so the arrow covers the pack twice.
- On a boss: the boss takes 2 arrow hits per shot, one going out and one coming back. Fire with the boss between you and a wall for the shortest round trip and the fastest repeat hits.

How the targeting works: every tick fires its 3 zaps no matter how many enemies are in range.
- In a mob: zaps spread to new targets, so the orb sweeps damage through the pack as it travels.
- Fewer than 3 enemies: the extra zaps go to enemies already in range.
- Lone boss: all 3 zaps hit the boss every tick.
expected.planner_notes:
Proposed numbers: the orb travels at about 50 px/s and zaps enemies within 70.

In game (hwp_wiz_tempest_torrent, tested): a slow orb along the aim that passes through enemies, stops at a wall and zaps 3 times every 250 ms within 70, new targets first.
